'''Velnine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was the apprentice of [[Darth Nurin]].

==Biography==
During the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]] of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], he was sent to [[Vaiken Spacedock]] where he would instruct Imperial operatives to meet with his master [[Darth Nurin]] aboard the ''[[Ziost Shadow]]'' in order to deal with the situation.<ref name="SWTORCiGC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Velnine first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' and served as a flashpoint courier for Imperial players to direct them to the flashpoint Kaon Under Siege.<ref name="SWTORCiGC" /> According to the text files for the game, Velnine was originally a droid named VN-99, but was changed to a Sith by the time of the game's release.
